name: Jointman | 0.65g x 23pk Infused Prerolls | Baller Baja Blast
description: The Jointman 23 Infused Pack isn’t for lightweights. This is 23 pre-rolls, each packed with 0.65 grams of infused heat — we’re talking premium flower, drenched in THC oil, layered with terps, and stuffed with kief all inside the joint for a smooth, even burn that slaps hard from the jump. No dip. No gimmicks. Just potent, flavor-loaded joints that get you lifted fast — and keep you there.
